title: Ohm's law: current, voltage and resistance
label: kit-verified
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline' http://localhost:3001/vendor/; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; font-src http://localhost:3001/vendor/ data:; connect-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none';">
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Ohm's law: current, voltage and resistance</title>
</head>
<body>
<script src="/vendor/kit/0.1.0/core.js"></script>
<script>
  var env = Synapse.environment({ title: "Ohm's law: current, voltage and resistance", note: "In an ohmic conductor the current is proportional to the voltage and inversely proportional to the resistance.", kicker: "Interactive physics lab", tryThis: "Explore how the current changes with the voltage and the resistance." });
  
  var c_voltage = Synapse.slider(env, {"id": "voltage", "label": "Voltage", "unit": "V", "min": 0.0, "max": 12.0, "value": 6.0, "grid": 12});
  var c_resistance = Synapse.slider(env, {"id": "resistance", "label": "Resistance", "unit": "ohm", "min": 1.0, "max": 20.0, "value": 4.0, "grid": 19});
  
  var m_conductor = Synapse.ohm({ resistance: c_resistance, voltage: c_voltage });
  Synapse.readout(env, { label: "Current", unit: "A", value: m_conductor, digits: 3 });
  
  Synapse.apparatus(env, { kind: "circuit", label: "Circuit", channels: { "current": { value: m_conductor, full: 12.0 } } });
  Synapse.apparatus(env, { kind: "gauge", label: "Ammeter", channels: { "value": { value: m_conductor, full: 12.0 } } });
  Synapse.graph(env, { title: "The current rises in a straight line as the voltage rises.", x: c_voltage, y: m_conductor, yLabel: "Current", yUnit: "A", digits: 3 });
  Synapse.graph(env, { title: "Drag the point along the graph to change the resistance and watch the current.", x: c_resistance, y: m_conductor, yLabel: "Current", yUnit: "A", digits: 3 });
  
  Synapse.text(env, "Try a resistance of 4 ohm and then 20 ohm at the same voltage.");
  Synapse.hintLadder(env, { hints: ["Change one control at a time.", "What happens to the current when the voltage rises and the resistance stays the same?", "Current equals voltage divided by resistance."] });
  Synapse.conceptCheck(env, {"question": "If the voltage stays the same and the resistance is doubled, what happens to the current?", "options": ["It doubles", "It halves", "It stays the same"], "correct": 1, "explanation": "The current is inversely proportional to the resistance, so doubling the resistance halves the current."});
  
  Synapse.reset(env);
  Synapse.bridge.ready();
</script>
</body>
</html>
